title: Tanzeem e Imamat ki Alamdar Hai Zainab
body:
Tanzeeme imamat ki alamdaar hai zainab
Yu hausulaye aabide beemar hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ek sadmaye paiham me giraftaar hai zainab
Bekas hai magar khaafila salaar hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Koofe ka wo hangaama wo baalo me chupa rukh
Be makhnaw-o-chadar sare bazaar hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Abbas na qasim hai na ham shakle payambar
Ab gham me bahattar ke dilafgaar hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Baade shahe sultaane zaman karbobala me
Islaam ki har tarha madadgaar hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Zainab KI zaba se ye ali bol rahe hai
Aye zarbe alam aahani deewaar hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Isalaam pe aa sakta nahi harf yakheenan
Baatil ke liye deen ki talwaar hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Beti wo ali ki hai nawaasi hai nabi ki
Kirdaar me guftaar me karrar hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kyu aur kisi dar pe bhala jaaye sulaimaan
Jab uski shafa at ki bhi mukhtaar hai zainab
